tweetText: Google is merging Display Ads into its AI-driven Demand Gen platform, ending a nearly 20-year digital ad model. This shift impacts how marketers will target and test ads, reflecting the growing dominance of AI in advertising. via AI News.
AI bots are transforming Forex trading by using data and automation for faster, more disciplined decision-making. This shift helps traders navigate market volatility more effectively. via AI News.

Cisco and OpenAI are teaming up to enhance enterprise engineering with Codex, boosting AI development and automating defect fixes. This collaboration could transform how companies leverage AI for efficiency and security. via OpenAI News
Google's AI struggles with spelling, failing to accurately spell its own name. This highlights ongoing challenges in AI development and raises concerns about reliability. via TechCrunch AI

Snowflake has inked a massive $6B deal with Amazon Web Services to secure AI CPU chips over the next five years. This move strengthens Amazon's position in the AI market and challenges Nvidia's dominance. via TechCrunch AI

Payroll startup Remote hit over $300M in annual revenue and became cash-flow positive after boosting revenue per employee by 50% through AI. This shows how tech can drive efficiency and growth without increasing staff. via TechCrunch AI

Google I/O confirmed that AI-generated answers will dominate search results, leaving many brands in the dark about their online presence. This shift disrupts traditional SEO strategies built around classic search results. via TechCrunch AI

Meta is introducing paid subscriptions for Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp globally, and is exploring new AI and creator features. This move could reshape how users engage with these platforms and open new revenue streams. via TechCrunch AI

AI coding startup Cognition has raised $1B, now valued at $25B, after hitting a $492M annual revenue run rate. This rapid growth highlights the increasing demand for AI-driven solutions in software development. via TechCrunch AI

China's AI boom is leading to a surge in top talent, and the government is now focused on keeping these experts within its borders. This could shift the global AI landscape and impact international competition. via TechCrunch AI
